oc_background_task_missing.auto_fix: Register missing cron or heartbeat entry per SKILL.md declaration
oc_background_task_missing.description: Declared background task not found in cron registry or HEARTBEAT.md

oc_commons_dir_missing.description: Skill journal payload missing, blocking inter-skill signal delivery

oc_cron_disabled_transient.description: Cron job transiently disabled, likely from a failed run or timeout

oc_cron_stuck_missed.description: Cron job missed its scheduled run window
oc_cron_stuck_missed.reversibility: No side effects -- run was already missed

oc_cron_timeout.description: Cron job hit idle timeout waiting for provider response -- may indicate API issue or oversized prompt

oc_email_delivery_failed.auto_fix: Ensure config.yaml has platforms.email.enabled: true and platforms.email.address: mx.indigo.karasu@gmail.com; ensure deliver field uses 'email:google-workspace-user' format not bare 'email'
oc_email_delivery_failed.description: Email delivery failing because bare 'email' deliver target or missing platform config

oc_email_not_configured.auto_fix: Set platforms.email.enabled: false in config.yaml (or provide EMAIL_ADDRESS, EMAIL_PASSWORD, EMAIL_IMAP_HOST, EMAIL_SMTP_HOST in .env)
oc_email_not_configured.description: Email platform enabled in config.yaml but IMAP/SMTP credentials not configured in .env. Gateway reports 'No adapter available' on startup.
oc_email_not_configured.reversibility: Set platforms.email.enabled: true and provide credentials

oc_gateway_process_down.description: Gateway process is not running -- requires manual restart

oc_gateway_token_missing.description: Gateway authentication token missing or invalid

oc_google_token_invalid.description: Google OAuth token invalid or revoked -- agent profile token (with gmail.send scope) needs to be restored
match_patterns: token has been expired or revoked

oc_journal_dir_missing.description: Skill journal directory missing, blocking journal writes

oc_jsonl_malformed_lines.description: JSONL file contains malformed JSON lines blocking parsing
oc_jsonl_malformed_lines.reversibility: Move .error lines back to original file

oc_jsonl_oversized.description: JSONL log file exceeded max_records threshold, needs rotation

oc_disk_full.description: Root filesystem is 100% full. Backup job failed with 'No space left on device'. state.db is large, state-snapshots is large, sessions is large.
oc_disk_full.reversibility: Clean up state-snapshots directory, prune old sessions, WAL checkpoint state.db

oc_http_401_invalid_api_key.description: API key authentication failure (401/403). Check OpenRouter API key validity, rate limits, or credential issues.
oc_http_401_invalid_api_key.reversibility: Validate API key in .env and config.yaml; check if key is missing, expired, or rate-limited

oc_http_404_model_deprecated.description: Vision/auxiliary client auto-detects tencent/hy3-preview:free which returned HTTP 404. The model transitioned to paid. Affects cron jobs that use LLM API.
match_patterns: HTTP 404: Hy3 preview is no longer available as a free model
Hy3 preview is no longer available
oc_http_404_model_deprecated.reversibility: Update config.yaml to set fallback_model or change the default model from hy3-preview to a currently available model like openrouter/owl-alpha

oc_provider_config_mismatch.description: Invalid config key in providers section (e.g., providers.ollama.enabled which is not a valid key), causing repeated warning logs

oc_node_version_mismatch.description: Node.js version does not meet platform requirements

oc_oauth_token_expiring.auto_fix: OAuth refresh (only when token still valid, expiry <= 12h)
oc_oauth_token_expiring.description: OAuth token approaching expiry, proactive refresh needed
oc_oauth_token_expiring.reversibility: Token was valid before refresh -- no rollback needed

oc_platform_auto_detected_no_config.auto_fix: Add explicit platforms.{name}.enabled: false to config.yaml to override env-var auto-detection
oc_platform_auto_detected_no_config.description: Gateway auto-detects platform from *_ENABLED env vars or service-specific env vars (e.g. TWILIO_*) even when no explicit platform entry exists in config.yaml. Platform repeatedly fails to start (missing webhook URL, etc.) generating log spam. Fix: add explicit enabled: false to suppress auto-detection.
oc_platform_auto_detected_no_config.reversibility: Remove the platforms.{name} entry from config.yaml
oc_platform_auto_detected_no_config.technology_context: Hermes gateway platform auto-detection from environment variables

oc_port_collision.description: Port 18789 in use by another process -- requires manual resolution

oc_skill_data_dir_missing.description: Skill data directory or config.json missing, skill uninitialized

oc_skill_uninitialized.auto_fix: Create storage dirs, default config.json, empty JSONL files
oc_skill_uninitialized.description: Installed skill has no data directory, config, or journal directory

oc_systemd_linger_disabled.description: systemd linger not enabled -- background services will not persist across logout

oc_cron_dead_skill_ref.auto_fix: Remove the dead skill reference from the job's `skills` array in jobs.json, or delete the job if the skill was its only purpose
oc_cron_dead_skill_ref.description: Cron job references a skill directory that does not exist on disk (e.g., `google-workspace`, `weave-enrichment-proper`, `mcp-mempalace`). The job may still run if its prompt contains standalone instructions, but the skill loading will fail silently or produce errors.
oc_cron_dead_skill_ref.reversibility: Re-add the skill directory or restore the skills array entry

oc_cron_duplicate_function.auto_fix: Remove the duplicate cron job (keep the one with the lower/smaller ID or the one whose name matches the SKILL.md canonical name)
oc_cron_duplicate_function.description: Two or more cron jobs perform the same function — detected by identical script paths, identical prompts, or identical display names. Duplicates waste resources and can cause race conditions.
oc_cron_duplicate_function.reversibility: Re-create the deleted job from backup or SKILL.md declaration

oc_cron_dead_script_ref.auto_fix: Update the job's `script` field to the correct path, or delete the job if the script is intentionally removed
oc_cron_dead_script_ref.description: Cron job references a script file that does not exist on disk. The job will fail at execution time with a file-not-found error.
oc_cron_dead_script_ref.reversibility: Restore the script file or update the script field
